speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Herrings. Sit. I have aired you, and now I mean to examine you. Did you give your wife her opinion of the forsworn gentlemen?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She said the ladies were right to make them wait, and a twelvemonth was short.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: That is the longest she has gone without a ruling since I have known the table. I counted one herring. I would not have bet a second.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The ruling can wait on the bone. The loaf is the next accused. A finger and a half short of the notch. Mark me. I am not in the habit of imagining bread.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I set it by the board. It was a finger short when you left, and it is a finger and a half now. I did not put it on a pan. The notch is the measure in this house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A finger and a half. I see it. I am not arguing the notch against a penny loaf.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The country, Master Shakespeare. I ask only that. Is the corn up?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is up and thin.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Up and thin is a thing I know. In a thin year the shuttle still goes. I did not ask you for a price.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nor will I. A price is how a table becomes a market, and I keep a table. Alse, your question, before the herring makes me kind.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Are the children like you?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The elder girl corrects me. The younger mocks me. The boy outruns me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then they're well.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Well is a short word for three children. I would have taken a story. A story is how I know a house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The story is the three sentences. The elder will not let a wrong word stand. The younger wants a song this lane has not had. The boy has a wheel that goes aside and then true.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A wheel that goes is a good wheel. You have a busy house. I have a quiet room. Both are ways of living.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Philosophy is not in the threepence. Threepence. I will take it now, while I remember I am a landlady and not a convert.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence. For the meal. I am not opening the coffer to do it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is under the bench, which is a mercy. He has had the book enough this week. I will not fetch him up to be another opinion.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your wife has outflanked me. A twelvemonth, called short, by a woman who was not at my table. I shall think about that without your help.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Think without me. I have delivered her sentence as she said it. I have not improved it into one of mine.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then the table has what it asked. Corn thin. Children busy. A loaf a little shorter. I go back to the loom. I am still Master Verbeke, and the room is still mine.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go. And you, Master Shakespeare, may go up when the threepence is on the board and not in a speech. There. I have taken it. The examination is over.
